# Auracare AI

> Auracare Health Ltd is a UK healthcare AI company building two products on one patient model: Auracle, a consumer wellness companion that lives in the messaging apps you already use, and Auracare, clinician-facing clinical decision support that works in the background during the consultation. Both are in development. The company was founded in 2025 and is currently raising its seed round.

Key facts:

- Company: Auracare Health Ltd, registered in the United Kingdom, founded 2025.
- Founders: Tanush Pandey, Stephen Okita (CTO), and Hinlun Chen.
- Auracle (consumer): turns data from wearables and apps you already use (Apple, Google, Oura, Whoop, Fitbit, Garmin, Withings, Dexcom, Samsung) into a living model of you — a digital twin — then checks in over your messaging apps with a morning brief, nudges only when they matter, and an evening wrap. Replying is the logging. It is a general-wellness product, not a medical device.
- Auracare (clinical): decision support for clinicians that reasons over the twin's lifestyle summary, live vitals, and the conversation itself, using a neuro-symbolic reasoning loop for grounded, traceable suggestions — so the clinician keeps their eyes on the patient.
- Contact: hello@auracare.org.uk

## Products

- [Auracle](https://auracare.org.uk/product): The health companion that texts you back — a personal digital twin built from your wearables and apps, delivered through your existing messaging apps.
- [Auracare](https://auracare.org.uk/product/auracare): Clinician-facing clinical decision support that works inside the consultation without getting in the way. In development.
